Adding new features not present in the Kotlin codebase.

relationships: LegacyInput contract must map deterministically to ModernizedOutput contract

standards_guidance.name: Android Architecture: MVVM + Unidirectional State Flow
engineering_actions: Keep UI state in a ViewModel exposed as StateFlow or Compose State.
Treat ViewModel as the single source of truth for screen-level state.
Emit one-shot side effects via a Channel / SharedFlow, not LiveData.

standards_guidance.name: Jetpack Compose-First UI
engineering_actions: New screens must be Composable functions; legacy XML layouts are interop bridges only.
Preview every screen with `@Preview` variants for light / dark / RTL.
Use Material 3 components unless an explicit design-system override exists.

standards_guidance.name: Offline-First Data Policy
engineering_actions: Reads must resolve from local cache first; network refresh is async.
Mutations enqueue to WorkManager or an equivalent persistent queue.
Conflict resolution is explicit (last-writer-wins or merge), never silent.

standards_guidance.name: Mobile Security Baseline
engineering_actions: Secrets at rest go through Android Keystore, never SharedPreferences.
Network calls to private APIs must use certificate pinning.
Release builds must enable R8 / ProGuard with keep rules for reflection points.

non_negotiables: All user-visible strings must be in string resources for localization.
No network calls on the main thread — use coroutines with Dispatchers.IO.
Every screen has at least one Compose preview and one instrumented test.
Release builds must pass lint with `-Werror` for critical severity rules.

must.title: Security
must.description: Ensure the Go application adheres to security best practices.
must.metric: Zero critical vulnerabilities in security scans
acceptance_criteria: Security scans show no critical vulnerabilities.
All sensitive data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
NFR-002 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: Ensure the Go application is reliable and available.
acceptance_criteria: Automated recovery processes are in place.
NFR-004 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.

should.title: Performance
should.description: The Go application must perform at least as well as the Kotlin application.
should.metric: Response time under 200ms for 95% of requests
acceptance_criteria: Load tests show response times within target.
No significant performance regressions compared to Kotlin.
NFR-001 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99

should.title: Scalability
should.description: The Go application must scale to handle increased load.
should.metric: Handle 2× current user load without degradation
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests confirm handling of increased load.
No performance bottlenecks under scaled conditions.
NFR-003 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.

should.title: Usability
should.description: The Go application must be user-friendly and easy to navigate.
should.metric: User satisfaction score of 4.5/5 or higher
acceptance_criteria: Usability tests confirm ease of use.
NFR-005 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.
should.verification: Usability testing with target user group
